sourceQuote: Applicants who have given up their original Chinese citizenship (including residents in Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan) and become foreign citizens shall provide the documents certifying the cancellation of Chinese citizenship and household registration, according to the policy of the Ministry of Education of the PRC.
targetQuote: 已放弃原中国国籍（包括香港、澳门和台湾居民）并成为外国公民者，须按照中华人民共和国教育部政策提供证明注销中国国籍及户籍的文件。
